beforeAfterSection.title: The change in one line
beforeAfterSection.copy: A quick look at where students started and where they ended up.

beforeAfter.before: I had already attempted the NCLEX-RN once, but I struggled to understand why I was getting questions wrong. I knew the nursing concepts but found it difficult to prioritize the most important information in a question and apply clinical judgment. I was using multiple study resources without a clear structure and wasn't sure what I should focus on each day..
beforeAfter.after: I passed my next NCLEX-RN attempt with confidence.
